summary: D.C. and Virginia are currently suing the Trump administration over a proposed triumphal arch, while statehood advocates continue highlighting D.C.'s population size relative to existing states and documenting what they characterize as repeated attacks on the District's local authority. Voting information and updates on the statehood campaign's current status are also circulating as the election cycle progresses. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no senators, and their one delegate to the House cannot vote on the House floor.
